semiconductor_relevance: High — BNSR provides critical tools for verifying process conditions during the etching phase of semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: BNSR specializes in the development of Sensor on Wafer (SOW) technology, which is essential for monitoring and verifying process conditions during the etching phase of semiconductor manufacturing. Their SOW tools are designed to match production wafers, allowing for direct integration into processing equipment and providing real-time data on essential parameters.
capabilities: Sensor on Wafer (SOW) for etching process verification
Real-time monitoring of ESC and chamber temperature
Digitized and visualized data for intuitive process assessment
